description.value: Mount Arrowsmith Brewing Company is a family-run craft brewery in Parksville producing a wide range of award-winning hand-crafted beers, from crisp lagers and hazy IPAs to a spruce-tip brut IPA made with locally foraged Sitka tips. Their west-coast themed tasting room pours pints, flights, and cans to go, while the newly opened Arrowsmith Smokehouse adds Southern-style BBQ with house-smoked meats, pizzas, and handhelds. The brewery is a genuine community hub on mid-Vancouver Island, regularly hosting live music nights and an annual craft beer and mini-putt festival in Parksville.
